Exploitability_explanation: The vulnerable API (SSH server with GSSAPI mechanism validation) is not declared or called in any active code path. Viper acts only as a client for remote configuration services.
The vulnerable API (ForwardToAgent or ServeAgent in ssh/agent) is not found in the codebase. Viper does not have any SSH agent interaction.
Viper uses gRPC only as a client for etcd/consul and does not run a gRPC server with the path-based authorization required for this exploit.
